definitions.explanation: Of the highest moral, intellectual, or spiritual value. Describes ideals, purposes, or experiences that inspire awe and reverence.

examples.japanese: {崇高|すうこう}な⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{崇高|すうこう}な{美|うつく}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}たれた→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: I was struck by the sublime beauty of nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人命|じんめい}→人命：04286_jinmei⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{崇高|すうこう}な⟦{使命|しめい}→使命：11445_shimei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: They work to fulfill the noble mission of saving human lives.

notes:
{崇高|すうこう} is a literary, elevated na-adjective describing things that inspire deep respect or awe — noble ideals, sublime beauty, or lofty purposes. Not used for everyday matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {崇高|すうこう}な⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧: lofty ideals
- {崇高|すうこう}な⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: noble spirit
- {崇高|すうこう}な⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: lofty purpose
- {崇高|すうこう}な⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧: noble sacrifice
- {崇高|すうこう}な⟦{使命|しめい}→使命：11445_shimei⟧: noble mission

REGISTER:
This is a formal, literary word. It appears in speeches, essays, and serious writing. It would sound out of place in casual conversation.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{崇|あが}める→崇める：10026_agameru⟧: to revere, to worship (related verb)
- ⟦{高貴|こうき}→高貴：10167_kouki⟧: noble, distinguished (similar but for rank/birth)
- {気高|けだか}い: noble, dignified (i-adjective with similar meaning)
